title: Sprint 3 — Aggregation Framework
description: Master the aggregation pipeline — the most powerful feature of MongoDB for data transformation.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Pipeline Basics
tickets.description:
Use match and project.
Use group and accumulators.
Use sort, limit and skip in pipelines.

tasks.title: Task 3.1.1 — $match & $project
tasks.description: Build an aggregation pipeline to filter documents and reshape them by selecting specific fields.

tasks.title: Task 3.1.2 — $group & Accumulators
tasks.description: Group documents by a specific key and calculate aggregate values like sums or averages using accumulators.

tasks.title: Task 3.1.3 — $sort, $limit, $skip in Pipelines
tasks.description: Order aggregation results, limit the number of documents returned, and skip documents for pagination.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Intermediate Aggregation
tickets.description:
Use unwind for arrays.
Use lookup for joins.
Use addFields and computed fields.
Use facet for multi-dimensional analytics.

tasks.title: Task 3.2.1 — $unwind for Arrays
tasks.description: Deconstruct array fields to process each array element as a separate document in the aggregation pipeline.

tasks.title: Task 3.2.2 — $lookup (Joins in MongoDB)
tasks.description: Perform a left outer join to combine documents from two different collections.

tasks.title: Task 3.2.3 — $addFields, $set & Computed Fields
tasks.description: Add new fields or modify existing ones based on calculations within the aggregation pipeline.

tasks.title: Task 3.2.4 — $facet for Multi-Dimensional Analytics
tasks.description: Run multiple independent aggregation pipelines within a single stage to generate diverse analytics.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Advanced Aggregation
tickets.description:
Use bucket and bucketAuto.
Use graphLookup for graph traversal.
Use window functions with setWindowFields.

tasks.title: Task 3.3.1 — $bucket & $bucketAuto
tasks.description: Categorize documents into specific ranges or let MongoDB automatically determine the buckets for you.

tasks.title: Task 3.3.2 — $graphLookup (Graph Traversal)
tasks.description: Perform recursive searches to traverse hierarchical or graph-like relationships between documents.

tasks.title: Task 3.3.3 — Window Functions ($setWindowFields)
tasks.description: Perform operations on a specified span of documents in a collection, such as calculating moving averages.
